title: ExportJob
description: An export job (plan/EXPORT_PLAN.md P-EX1): GET /api/exports/{id}, stored as <project>/exports/<id>/job.json. Statuses: queued (waiting for the one export slot), running, done (report and FMU), refused (the model or the scope cannot be exported: diagnostics say why), failed (an internal error), cancelled.

model.description: The model name in the project.

scope.description: The exported subsystem's instance path; null for the whole model.

phase.title: ExportJobPhase
phase.description: What a running job does now: starting (Julia loads BGSim), scope, flatten, reference (the reference run), export (analysis and C), build (compile, checks, zip).

error.description: A user-facing message for a refused or failed job.

diagnostics.description: The refusal's diagnostics (E110, E111, E112, ...) or the report's warnings.

notes.description: Plain sentences about the job (a reference run that did not finish, a source-only FMU).

fmu.description: The built FMU, downloadable at GET /api/exports/{id}/fmu.

timings.title: ExportTimings
timings.description: Wall time in seconds of each step that ran.

exportS.description: Lowering, spectrum analysis, Jacobian and C emission.

buildS.description: Compile, symbol and C++ checks, allocation harness, zip.
